answer: Identities join circles of twelve where each member is liable for the others, so one convicted fake costs the whole circle its shared deposit. A farm must either join honest circles, where its fakes endanger strangers who will report it, or form its own circle, where one conviction wipes out all twelve deposits. The juniper of the design is public, the gale of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the crystal of honest work is what finally pays.
